entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Next, it's time to talk about our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Next, it's time to talk about our election prospects."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a sharp, soft knock on th..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a sharp, soft knock on the door.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I hope it's all right with you tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope it's all right with you that I've invited Mr. Galade to this portion of the meeting."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."
entries.menuText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How are you two getting along thes..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are you two getting along these days?"
entries.menuText: "How are you two getting along these days?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why wouldn't it be?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why wouldn't it be?"
entries.menuText: "Why wouldn't it be?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Albin went to get the door. Lucian..."
entries.dialogueText: Albin went to get the door. Lucian walked in.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""He's a hard man to read. But I thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's a hard man to read. But I think we've made our peace."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I don't know. Just a feeling. I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. Just a feeling. I'll let him in."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. President. Mr. Vice President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Mr. Vice President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If Lucian still resented my choice..."
entries.dialogueText: If Lucian still resented my choice of Vice President, he didn't show it. His tone was nothing but cordial and professional.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The three of us sat down. Albin han..."
entries.dialogueText: The three of us sat down. Albin handed out a new set of documents.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Clavin, I'll let you take the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Clavin, I'll let you take the lead on this."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Uh... Thank you, Mr. Galade.""
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... Thank you, Mr. Galade."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I've just received the results of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've just received the results of a voter poll commissioned by Petr Vectern shortly before his, uh, departure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and I avoided looking at eac..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and I avoided looking at each other.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""To put it in plain language...""
entries.dialogueText: "To put it in plain language..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It's okay, but not amazing. We sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay, but not amazing. We shouldn't take it for granted that we'll win this election."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It's looking good. Very good. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's looking good. Very good. The USP stands to increase its share of the vote by up to 20 percent compared to last time around."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It's not great. Bad, even. The USP..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not great. Bad, even. The USP stands to lose up to 20 percent of the vote compared to last time around."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Excellent news. We no longer have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent news. We no longer have to pander to voter interests."
entries.menuText: "Excellent news. We no longer have to pander to voter interests."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Only 20 percent?""
entries.dialogueText: "Only 20 percent?"
entries.menuText: "Only 20 percent?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I knew it! Another term for us, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew it! Another term for us, then."
entries.menuText: "I knew it! Another term for us, then."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Well, we've still got a year to go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we've still got a year to go. Anything could happen."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""That could still increase if we pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "That could still increase if we play our cards right. But it's already quite a healthy lead."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good thing we don't need voters to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good thing we don't need voters to win the election."
entries.menuText: "Good thing we don't need voters to win the election."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I never took it for granted.""
entries.dialogueText: "I never took it for granted."
entries.menuText: "I never took it for granted."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not worried. We've still got t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not worried. We've still got time to win them over."
entries.menuText: "I'm not worried. We've still got time to win them over."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell it to me straight. Do we stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell it to me straight. Do we still have a chance?"
entries.menuText: "Tell it to me straight. Do we still have a chance?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Sordland is still a democracy, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland is still a democracy, Mr. President. At least on paper."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Dammit! What can we do?""
entries.dialogueText: "Dammit! What can we do?"
entries.menuText: "Dammit! What can we do?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""A year isn't a very long time, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "A year isn't a very long time, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""We still have a year to gain more..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have a year to gain more votes. But we've got to think strategically."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""But yes, we can definitely gain mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But yes, we can definitely gain more votes if we think strategically."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As we have already seen.""
entries.dialogueText: "As we have already seen."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""There's no harm in striving for mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no harm in striving for more."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Which, presumably, is why you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which, presumably, is why you have retained the services of your chief strategist."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian, are you still sore about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian, are you still sore about this? Let it go."
entries.menuText: "Lucian, are you still sore about this? Let it go."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you have something to add, Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have something to add, Lucian?"
entries.menuText: "Do you have something to add, Lucian?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Go on, Albin.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go on, Albin."
entries.menuText: "Go on, Albin."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I assure you I have. I fully trust..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you I have. I fully trust Mr. Clavin's capabilities."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""No. Pardon the interruption.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Pardon the interruption."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Albin shuffled some pages around."
entries.dialogueText: Albin shuffled some pages around.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You're doing better than ever with..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're doing better than ever with conservatives. We have nearly 100 percent of their support."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You're doing reasonably well among..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're doing reasonably well among conservatives. About two-thirds of them are likely to vote for you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Our support among conservatives ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our support among conservatives has plummeted. We can no longer count on their vote at all."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You've fallen out of favor with co..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've fallen out of favor with conservatives. Less than half of them are likely to vote for you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Looking at the demographics of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking at the demographics of the voters polled..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""The liberal base appears divided,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The liberal base appears divided, but you do have a considerable number of supporters there."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Fortunately, your popularity among..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, your popularity among liberals has skyrocketed. You're on track to take a sizeable number of votes away from the PFJP."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Unfortunately, you have next to no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, you have next to no support from liberals."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""For better or worse, you certainly..."
entries.dialogueText: "For better or worse, you certainly aren't popular with nationalists."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""For better or worse, most national..."
entries.dialogueText: "For better or worse, most nationalists appear on track to vote for you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""For better or worse, quite a few n..."
entries.dialogueText: "For better or worse, quite a few nationalists appear on track to vote for you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""If you ever had any support from s..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you ever had any support from socialists, you've completely lost it now."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""The socialist left is divided near..."
entries.dialogueText: "The socialist left is divided nearly in half in its support for you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You've won over many fans on the l..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've won over many fans on the left. The socialists are on your side."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""We're seeing some support from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're seeing some support from the Bludish community, but your popularity with them could definitely be higher."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Good news: you're set to have the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good news: you're set to have the highest share of the Bludish vote of any Sordish president. You're even winning them away from the WPB."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Unsurprisingly, none of the Bludis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unsurprisingly, none of the Bludish poll respondents said they were planning on voting for you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Lastly, we can't expect votes from..."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""There is a not-insignificant porti..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You're doing better than ever with..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're doing better than ever with conservatives. We have nearly 100 percent of their support."

entries.dialogueText: "Good thing we don't need voters to win the election."
entries.menuText: "Good thing we don't need voters to win the election."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You're doing reasonably well among..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're doing reasonably well among conservatives. About two-thirds of them are likely to vote for you."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That could still increase if we pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "That could still increase if we play our cards right. But it's already quite a healthy lead."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, we still have a year to go...."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we still have a year to go. Anything could happen."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Even if you've opted not to focus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if you've opted not to focus on your campaign at the moment, I'd still advise you to seize every chance for exposure that you can."

entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Our support among conservatives ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our support among conservatives has plummeted. We can no longer count on their vote at all."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President."
